mainText: President Trump stated that Bill Pulte will not serve as U.S. intelligence chief on a permanent basis.

mainText: Dutch police investigate suspected drugging and sexual assault of multiple women.

titleText: JTF News: World Health Organization, UN News
mainText: The World Health Organization reports that unsafe food causes 1.5 million deaths annually, with children disproportionately affected.

titleText: JTF News: European Commission, Irish Times
mainText: The Commission referred Ireland to the Court of Justice of the European Union for failing to comply with the Environmental Impact Assessment Directive regarding peat cutting projects.
